question: Should OpenClaw add a separate initial-ack emoji choice contract, and if so which selection semantics should it guarantee?
rationale: The capability remains absent, but choosing deterministic rotation, randomness, rules, or model-driven selection defines a new cross-channel config and timing contract that cannot be inferred safely from current behavior.

options.title: Add bounded choice strategy
options.body: Keep the singular value compatible and add an opt-in emoji list with a documented deterministic or random selection policy and channel fallbacks.

options.title: Use lifecycle reactions only
options.body: Decline another initial-ack surface and document lifecycle status reactions as the supported varied-feedback mechanism.

options.title: Add model-driven selection
options.body: Let the agent classify message tone before acknowledging, accepting additional latency, cost, and nondeterminism.

recommendation.title: Add bounded choice strategy
recommendation.body: Keep the singular value compatible and add an opt-in emoji list with a documented deterministic or random selection policy and channel fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared feedback controller and initial multi-channel architecture appear to originate from their merged work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-channel design choice.
